title: Data & AI Product Owner
description:
This is an opportunity to join a global business that is investing heavily in data, analytics and artificial intelligence to transform how products and services are delivered. You will take ownership of developing Data and AI products, working closely with technical teams and senior stakeholders to shape solutions from concept through to launch and adoption.


The Company

They are a well-established professional services organisation with a strong focus on innovation, technology and data-driven decision making. Significant investment is being made across Data, Analytics and AI, with a dedicated product function being built to support a growing portfolio of strategic initiatives. The environment combines complex business challenges, senior stakeholder exposure and the opportunity to influence how Data & AI products are developed at scale.


The Role

You will play a key role in defining and delivering Data and AI products across the organisation.

Responsibilities include:

  • Identifying new opportunities for Data and AI products across the business
  • Leading discovery activities to understand problems, define use cases and validate requirements
  • Gathering and managing stakeholder requirements across multiple teams
  • Owning product roadmaps, priorities and backlog management
  • Making decisions on product direction, delivery priorities and feature development
  • Working closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and Engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle
  • Managing competing stakeholder demands and balancing commercial priorities
  • Supporting product launches, adoption and ongoing optimisation
  • Contributing to the wider Data & AI product strategy


Examples of projects include:

  • Data and analytics products that provide commercial and operational insights
  • Generative AI applications that support knowledge-intensive workflows
  • Workflow automation products powered by AI and machine learning


Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong commercial experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager
  • Proven experience delivering products from discovery and ideation through to launch
  • Experience owning and prioritising product backlogs and roadmaps
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including engagement with senior business leaders
  • Experience working with engineering, data science and technical delivery teams
  • Understanding of data products, analytics products or AI-enabled solutions
  • Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services or another complex regulated environment is advantageous
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms and cloud-based data ecosystems is beneficial
  • Knowledge of Generative AI use cases would be advantageous


What They Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package
  • Genuine ownership of product strategy, roadmap and prioritisation
  • Exposure to large-scale Data and AI initiatives with executive visibility
  • Clear opportunity to influence how the function evolves as it grows
  • Collaborative environment with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers and technology specialists


How to Apply

To learn more about this Data & AI Product Owner opportunity, please submit your application for a confidential discussion.
